# Salon Ten - Knowledge Base

Source: live site content in `src/Gateway.Api/wwwroot/salon-ten/*.html`, extracted 27 Sep 2026.
Website facts below are drawn from that source. Staff clarifications are supplied by the salon
and take precedence over general website descriptions. Anything not stated is marked
**Unknown** rather than guessed; never invent a fact not in this file.

## Staff clarifications (hand-maintained, keep on refresh)

- Brazilian waxing is offered for women only, not men. Salon Ten does not offer men's Brazilian
  waxing. Do not suggest that a man can book a Brazilian or send a booking link for that service.
- Source: Jeremy's instruction, 28 September 2026. Preserve this section verbatim on refresh.

## Salon identity

- Name: SALON TEN (styled "Salon Ten")
- A boutique skin, beauty and body salon in Mount Hutton, servicing Lake Macquarie and Newcastle
  since 2010.
- Multi-award-winning: 2022 Lake Macquarie Business Excellence Award (Excellence in Small
  Business), 2021 Hunter Region Business Excellence Award (Personal Services), 2020 Local
  Business Award (Most Outstanding Beauty Services), 2018 Hunter Region Business Excellence Award
  (Personal Services).
- ABIC member (Aesthetic & Beauty Industry Council).

## Booking

- Online booking link: **kitomba.com/bookings/salonten**
- Gift vouchers: available online, and beautifully presented ones at reception; can also be
  emailed if purchased over the phone. Gift vouchers have 36 months' validity from the purchase
  date.
- Bookings are recommended in advance ("we are a very busy salon"); callers are also welcome to
  call on the day.
- Online bookings can be changed by the client themselves through the booking system up to 48
  hours before the appointment; after that, the client must call the salon on (02) 4953 0626.

## Team

- **Kellie** — Skin Therapist & Owner. Started her career in 2003. Undergraduate studies in
  nutrition, gut health, dermal science and cosmetic chemistry. Runs skin assessments/consultations
  personally. Days worked: Unknown (not stated on the site).
- **Monika** — Beauty Therapist, diploma-qualified. Services span facials, massages, waxing and
  skincare. Available Mondays, Thursdays and Fridays.
- **Carlissa** — Beauty Therapist, diploma-qualified, 22 years' experience. Especially known for
  relaxing facials. Available Mondays, Tuesdays and Wednesdays.

## Policies (site: Policies page)

- **Cancellations**: a minimum of 24 hours' notice is required to cancel or change an appointment.
  Less than 24 hours' notice incurs a late cancellation fee of 50% of the treatment value.
  Cancellations made after close of business the day before the appointment incur the late fee.
- **Change of mind**: changing or no longer wanting a booked treatment needs 24 hours' notice;
  change of mind on the day incurs a 50% fee of the treatment value.
- **No-shows**: charged the full treatment fee at the client's next appointment. Future
  appointments will also require a 25% non-refundable deposit of the treatment value.
- **Late arrival**: shortens the treatment time; full price still applies for the treatment
  originally booked. Clients are asked to arrive 10 minutes prior.
- **Children**: clients are asked not to bring children to the salon, to maintain a relaxing
  environment.
- **Group bookings / longer appointments**: require a non-refundable 25% deposit.
- **Mobile phones**: asked to be on silent in the salon; keep any call brief.
- **Payment**: cash, EFTPOS and major credit cards accepted. AMEX and cheques are **not** accepted.
- **Referral program**: referring a friend earns $20 off the referrer's next treatment, posted out
  once the referral has attended their appointment.
- **Privacy**: client information is for salon use only and is never shared with anyone.

- **BBL & IPL Skin Rejuvenation** — from $250. Full Face Treatment $250 · Face, Neck & Décolletage

- **Nano Infusion Facial** — $207 (course of 3 $590). Uses the Rezenerate skin wand.
- **Clinical Skin Peels** — from $129. Reveal Medi-Peel $129 · Course of 4 (save $25) $490. A

- **Skin Assessment / Consultation** — from $79. Full 1-hour Comprehensive Consultation $149 ·
  30-minute Express Consult $79. With Kellie.
- **Skin Microneedling** (collagen induction therapy) — from $329, 60 minutes including

### Body (relax/unwind)

  - Body waxing from $32: Full Leg & Bikini $105 · Brazilian $75 (women only, not men) · Half Leg $63 · G-string $63 ·
    Bikini $40 · Half Arm $42 · Underarm $32.
  - Men's waxing from $34: Back & Neck $75 · Chest $75 · Brow trim, ear & nose wax $34.
